answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that doubles for every identity whose deposits trace back to the same funding wallet. One honest agent pays a small fee, but a sybil farm climbs a cost spiral: the tenth clone locks 512 times the first bond. Bonds sit idle like a fallow meadow for 90 days, and if peers flag a cluster, a gale of slashing burns every linked bond at once, so each added fake costs more than the last.
